biotools.summary: MetaMobilePicker is an open-source pipeline for identifying antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) associated with mobile genetic elements in metagenomic data. It combines existing tools to streamline the process of identifying ARGs linked to plasmids, insertion sequences, and phages, starting from short metagenomic sequencing reads.
